source_identity_note: Measured binary is isolated base 4be60d0 plus the exact combined CLDR patch. The runner records coordinator state, which initially included a separately held lexical/IsArray candidate. That candidate is not in this binary. Parent SQL test-support commit changes no engine code. Every integrated CLDR source file was compared byte-for-byte to the frozen worktree.

limitations: Warm filesystem-cache startup measurements; no installed-artifact promotion.
No new x86-64 or wasm32 execution evidence.
Application throughput remains near parity; number lookup/construction has a small measured cost.
This result does not establish an 8–10x overall engine gain.
Other runtime experiments remain held separately; their speedups are not included.
